description: This file defines a MapStruct interface for mapping JournalEntry domain entities to JournalEntryData transfer objects, including various field mappings and helper methods for converting types and enums.

classes.name: JournalEntryMapper
classes.description: A MapStruct mapper interface that converts JournalEntry domain objects into JournalEntryData transfer objects with detailed field mappings.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts a JournalEntry object into a JournalEntryData DTO, mapping individual fields and ignoring some internal or ignore-specific fields.

methods.name: mapEntityType
methods.description: Converts an Integer entity type ID to a PortfolioProductType enum.

methods.name: mapGlAccountType
methods.description: Converts an Integer GL account type ID to a GLAccountType enum.

methods.name: mapJournalEntryType
methods.description: Converts an Integer journal entry type ID to a JournalEntryType enum.

methods.name: mapGlAccountType
methods.description: Maps a GLAccountType enum to an EnumOptionData representation.

methods.name: mapJournalEntryType
methods.description: Maps a JournalEntryType enum to an EnumOptionData representation.

methods.name: mapEntityType
methods.description: Maps a PortfolioProductType enum to an EnumOptionData representation.

methods.name: mapCurrency
methods.description: Creates a CurrencyData object from a currency code string.
